example.title: Menter farmstead, barn, North Fork Road
example.place: Big Springs vicinity, Deuel County, NE

brief: Weathered plains stock barn: a tall central gable block with a hay door and small loft window, flanked by long lean-to aisles whose roofs break in pitch below the main eaves (a broken-gable western barn profile). Vertical boards weathered silver-grey with traces of old red paint low on the walls, wood-shingle roofs gone brown with moss and gaps. Beside it stands a hip-roofed grey granary with an open drive shed and a tall elevator head; short-grass pasture, barbed wire and bare cottonwoods around.
